name: divider
title: Divider
description: One hairline between sections, with an optional label.
use: A line between two sections, on an hr or an element with role="separator", after spacing and grouping have done what they can.

instead.when: The line stands between groups of controls in a toolbar
The line is a handle that resizes two panes

classes.name: divider-vertical
classes.description: A rule between items in a row; it takes the row's height

classes.name: divider-label
classes.description: The line parts around a caption such as "or". An hr cannot hold text, so it goes on an element with role="separator"
